name: Genoa

queries.query: Genoa Genova Italia catasto mappe catastali comune geoportale dati catastali official
queries.scope: Identify first-party local land-registry/cadastral sources and safe anonymous parcel geometry.
queries.result: Comune di Genova officially publishes Geoservizi WMS/WFS at https://mappe.comune.genova.it/geoserver/ows. An anonymous WFS 2.0 GetCapabilities request returned HTTP 200; cadastral-named entries exposed by that public service are historical cartographic layers (e.g. 1656, 1414, 1810, 1907), not a current parcel-feature layer. The official Geoportale guide marks Particelle catastali as reserved access. The national cadastral dataset listing for Comune di Genova advertises WMS/WFS, but the published municipal portal identifies that modern parcel layer as reserved; no GetFeature request was made against it. No public safe current-parcel geometry response was obtained.
queries.executionMethod: Separate English-language web search followed by official-source review.
